title: TimeSeriesCommon
description: Shared value types for the time series association schemas, mirroring the backing store's types. Only Features/FeatureValue names carry a TimeSeries prefix, since the bare names are too generic for a shared namespace.

OwnerCategory.title: OwnerCategory
OwnerCategory.description: Whether a time series' owner is a component or a supplemental attribute. Required regardless of id, since the store's catalog contract supports independent id streams from other producers.

TimeSeriesFeatureValue.title: TimeSeriesFeatureValue
TimeSeriesFeatureValue.description: One feature value: int, float, bool, or str. anyOf (not oneOf) because JSON Schema's integer is a subset of number. A float is compared and hashed by bit pattern, so 0.0 and -0.0 differ; NaN and negative zero are rejected on write.

TimeSeriesFeatures.title: TimeSeriesFeatures
TimeSeriesFeatures.description: User-defined key/value tags forming part of a series' identity. Excludes names already used by a series field or by the tuple addressing one, since a feature would otherwise shadow that field. Comparison is exact and case-sensitive.

ElementType.title: ElementType
ElementType.description: Canonical element type of the stored array: a dtype spelling (f64, f32, i64, i32, u64, u32, u16, u8, i16, i8, bool) for scalars, else tuple(N,dtype) or a function-data kind. Says what one timestep's value means and how it is laid out.

TimeReference.title: TimeReference
TimeReference.description: How a series' timestamps are spelled: utc; zoneless for a wall clock; a fixed UTC offset (-07:00, +0530); or an IANA zone name. Not a grid: does not change what resolution steps on.

Period.title: Period
Period.description: A time period as an ISO-8601 duration string, used for resolution, horizon, and interval. Fixed spans (PT1H, down to a millisecond floor) and calendar spans (P1M, P1Y) are never equal even when their spans coincide.
